name: Angelique Etoile
original_name: アンジェリーク エトワール
source:
Fourth installment in the series. The main character is a girl from the cosmos ruled by Angelique Limoges named Ange, who must save the cosmos as the "Legendary Etoile". Includes all of the major characters from previous Angelique titles, plus three new "Holy Beast Cosmos" Guardians.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angelique_(Japanese_series)]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
系列第四部正作。女主角是来自安琪莉可·立摩朱所统御宇宙的少女“安琪”，她必须肩负起“传说中的艾特瓦尔”之使命拯救宇宙。本作不仅集结了《安琪莉可》系列历代全部主要角色，还全新加入了三位“圣兽宇宙”守护圣。

[摘自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angelique_(Japanese_series)]维基百科[/url]]
